description: This file defines a GatewaySession class managing WebSocket connections to a gateway, including connection establishment, request handling, event processing, and re-connection logic, primarily for real-time communication in an Android environment.

classes.name: GatewayClientInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a gateway client including id, display name, version, platform, mode, and device details.

classes.name: GatewayConnectOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for establishing a gateway connection such as role, scopes, capabilities, commands, permissions, and user agent.

classes.name: GatewayConnectErrorDetails
classes.description: Contains detailed information about errors encountered during the gateway connection process.

classes.name: SelectedConnectAuth
classes.description: Encapsulates selected authentication tokens and source for connecting to the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket gateway sessions, handling connection, reconnection, message sending, event handling, and request invocation.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeRequest
classes.description: Represents an invocation request sent to a node via the gateway, including id, nodeId, command, params, and timeout.

classes.name: GatewaySession.InvokeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an invocation, indicating success, payload, and error details.

classes.name: GatewaySession.ErrorShape
classes.description: Defines the structure of error information returned from the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySession.Connection
classes.description: Handles an active WebSocket connection to the gateway, including request handling and message processing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a gateway connection with specified endpoint, token, options, and TLS parameters.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the active connection and cancels ongoing jobs.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Triggers a reconnect by closing the current connection.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends an event to the node with specified event name and payload JSON.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an RPC request over the WebSocket connection with specified method, params, and timeout.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Requests and updates the node canvas capability URL.

methods.name: connectOnce
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and manages its lifecycle.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrl
methods.description: Normalizes URL for the canvas host based on various parameters, ensuring correct scheme and port.

methods.name: buildConnectParams
methods.description: Constructs JSON parameters for the connect request including device info, auth, and client details.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, routing responses and events.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Handles RPC responses by matching request IDs and completing corresponding Deferreds.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events, including special handling for challenge and invoke requests.

methods.name: awaitConnectNonce
methods.description: Waits for a connect challenge nonce within a timeout.

methods.name: handleInvokeEvent
methods.description: Processes node invoke requests and dispatches handlers.

methods.name: sendInvokeResult
methods.description: Sends the result of an invoke request back over the WebSocket.
